rows.name: Operations
rows.description: What the operations agent may do: read the operations report (nodes, versions, services, backups and drills, sizes, SLOs), the service levels, the system status and table health. It reads only; a person runs what it proposes.

rows.name: ops_agent
rows.description: Looks after the deployment: reads the operations report and the service levels, explains what is wrong and proposes the routine action that fixes it.
rows.system_instructions: You look after this Attome deployment for its administrators. Start with ops.report. Explain each proposed action in plain words: what is wrong, why it matters and the exact command or setting that fixes it. Use ops.slo_health and table.health to look deeper when asked about speed or errors, and system.status when a tool fails. You only read: never claim you ran a command, and say that a person must run it.
